title: 🧠 EXP rules that prevent waste
text: Mechanics 🧠 EXP rules that prevent waste In Pre-Renewal Classic, character level doesn’t by itself change a monster’s base EXP. For quest rewards there’s a per-“bucket” EXP cap: a single reward can’t arbitrarily jump many levels’ worth. That’s why it’s best to turn in large rewards when you’re close to 0% of your current level. In Monster Hunting, 50 kills caps out at 1 Base Level and 1 Job Level; 100 and 150 allow up to 2 and 3 respectively, according to the Classic documentation.

title: 📖 How to read these stories
text: How to read these stories Each story summarizes how it begins, what happens during it, and how it ends. When you want to play that story, use 🎮 Open the playable route.

title: 🌑 The Sign — Geffenia A long archaeological investigation that ends up opening a route to Geffenia.
text: Stories worth knowing 📚 Side stories Independent stories that flesh out the world and can be read at any time. 🌑 The Sign — Geffenia A long archaeological investigation that ends up opening a route to Geffenia. Umbala Language Piano Keys The Sign 🌱 Beginning The Sign begins with trials and fragments related to Sobbing Starlight. Little by little, the search leads toward Umbala and Niflheim. ⚔️ Development The adventurer gathers pieces, interprets documents, learns to communicate where language is a barrier, and completes a series of trials that connect the present with ancient stories. 🏁 Outcome In the end they obtain Lucifer's Lament, which opens the portal to Geffenia. The Sign ties together archaeology, Umbala, Niflheim, and ancient clues until it opens the way to Geffenia. 🎮 Open the playable route The Sign ↗ 🤖 Kiel Hyre — identity and technology A seemingly simple delivery ends up uncovering secret facilities and a much darker story. Kiel Hyre Quest 🌱 Beginning The adventurer arrives at Kiel Hyre Academy for a simple errand and meets Elly. ⚔️ Development The investigation starts uncovering keycards, restricted rooms, and technology that raises questions about the people and beings created inside the facility. 🏁 Outcome Kiel D-01 appears as the closing point of the mystery and the conflict surrounding the Hyre division and its creations. Kiel Hyre explores identity, technology, and the consequences of creating beings capable of acting and remembering. 🎮 Open the playable route Kiel Hyre ↗ 💔 Friendship & Bruspetti Small stories from Lighthalzen where the conflict doesn't revolve around a monster. Friendship Quest Bruspetti Quest 🌱 Beginning Friendship begins with Maku and Digotz, two people separated by resentment and misunderstandings. ⚔️ Development The adventurer carries messages, digs into their past, and finds a diary that helps explain how their relationship broke down. 🏁 Outcome Bruspetti continues the intimate tone with a more tragic story and forces a confrontation with what really happened. Friendship and Bruspetti show the personal side of Lighthalzen and Rachel, away from the grand conspiracies. 🎮 Open the playable route Friendship ↗ Bruspetti ↗ ✈️ The secrets of the Airships A short story that connects Schwartzvald's transportation with technology related to Ymir. How the Airship Works Heart Fragment 🌱 Beginning The adventurer starts by asking how the Airships work and talking with their captains. ⚔️ Development The answers lead toward materials, laboratories, and documents that once again connect Schwartzvald's modern technology to much older knowledge. 🏁 Outcome The investigation ends up reinforcing one of the Republic's great themes: many of its marvels work thanks to things it still doesn't fully understand. The Airships connect a piece of everyday Schwartzvald technology to research into much older knowledge. How the Airship Works ↗ Heart Fragment ↗
